content: We will have our online session this Friday, August 7, 2026. This meeting will be dedicated to discussing the current status and coordination across all ongoing projects, answering questions about contributions, coding, and the review process, and addressing any other Statlib-related issues that would benefit from a live discussion. We will meet 2026-08-07T11:30:00-04:00 - 2026-08-07T13:00:00-04:00 and will use the following Zoom link: https://harvard.zoom.us/j/8971162061 . Going forward, we will meet every Friday at the same time using the same Zoom link.
